_scaffold: WHOOP 5.0 (Gen-5) protocol schema — SKELETON ONLY. The 5.0 BLE protocol is NOT yet decoded (see docs/2026-05-30-whoop-5.0-re-method.md and FINDINGS.md sections 6-7). This file intentionally contains no real layouts and is NOT loaded by any decoder yet. Populate enums/envelope/packets from your OWN gen5 captures (re/gen5/), then wire a loader as described in _wiring.
_wiring: Today the Python loader (server/packages/whoop-protocol/whoop_protocol/schema.py) and the Swift loader (Packages/WhoopProtocol/Sources/WhoopProtocol/WhoopProtocol.swift) each load the single 4.0 protocol/whoop_protocol.json. To activate Gen-5: (1) populate this file from captures; (2) add a generation selector to those two loaders; (3) add device-model detection (advertised name / GATT signature) in ios/OpenWhoop/BLE/BLEManager.swift and the re/gen5 scripts, choosing UUIDs + schema per generation.
